optimizedDescription.value: SkillRepository discovers metadata and safely renders capability-aware skill bundles.

optimizedContext.value:
# SkillRepository

## Rules

- `list()`: scan `templates/skills/`, `templates/agents/`; metadata-only `readonly Skill[]`; set `kind` from parent.
- `get(name: string)`: matching `Skill | undefined`.
- `getBundle(name, context?)`: load `skill.meta.json`; normalize capabilities; enforce `requiredCapabilities`; reject undeclared shared-template dependencies; recursively render variables + capabilities; return resolved `SkillBundle`. Callers never pre-normalize capabilities.
- `listSharedFiles()`: scan `templates/shared/`; return `SharedFile[]` (`filename`, `content`); select bundle shared files from skill `requiredSharedTemplates`, never inverse consumer index.
- Discover `specd-fasttrack` normally: metadata, local `SKILL.md`, declared shared files via list/get/bundle; never require `.agents/skills`, hard-coded registry, or plugin distribution path.

## Constraints

- Interface has no I/O; implementations do I/O.
- Bundle rendering supports structured install-time context, not only flat substitution.
- Source `.md.tpl` in `packages/skills/templates/` emits `.md`; filenames stay distinct.
- Variables support recursive template-path traversal.
- Preserve shared-file routing metadata.
- Shared inclusion follows `requiredSharedTemplates`.
- Normalize `sharedFolder` internally; rendered output never exposes absolute paths.
